name: Numenius of Tarsus
bio: Numenius of Tarsus is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors says the poet's date is unknown. Paton's index names him as of Tarsus.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XII: 28.

poems.title: Book XII, 28
poems.author: Numenius of Tarsus
poems.text: Cyrus is Lord (cyrius). What does it matter to me if he lacks a letter? I do not read the fair, I look on him.
